    assert original==path.read_bytes()
    inputs[path]=dict(file=relative,bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(path))

    checked=[x for x in prior['comparisons'] if x['position']==263168 and x['layer']==layer and x['stage']=='conv_f32']
    assert len(checked)==1 and checked[0]['comparison']['bf16_mismatches']==0
    weights[layer]=p;weight_files[layer]=item
silu=B/'qrt-silu-table-20260910-r2/capture/sm121-silu-bf16.bin'
assert sha(silu)=='673f8dd1280700578c1e8743afd2e3b4da134b1fbd463c890527e1c4d9f796b8'
D.mkdir();generated=D/'step124_convolution_kernel_r1.h'
assert not (B/generated.name).exists()
with generated.open('x') as f:f.write(kernel)
source=B/'step124_convolution_host_r1.cpp';exe=D/'step124-convolution-host'
args=['c++','-std=c++17','-O2','-ffp-contract=off','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror',
    '-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=all','-I',str(P),'-I',str(D),str(source),'-o',str(exe)]
compiled=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
with (D/'compile.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(dict(command=args,returncode=compiled.returncode,stdout=compiled.stdout,stderr=compiled.stderr),f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
compiled.check_returncode()
selected=[];results=[]
for position in (263168,263290,263291):
    choices=[(t,row) for t in w['transactions'] for row in t['qualified_rows'] if row['position']==position]
    assert len(choices)==1
    tx,row=choices[0]
    assert tx['token_count']==1 and not tx['discarded'] and row['row']==0 and row['matches_generated_history']
    selected.append(dict(position=position,transaction=tx['ordinal'],row=row))

    for layer in range(40):

        labels=[f'linear-{layer:02d}-'+s for s in ('qkv','conv-history-before','conv-history-after','conv-decode-output')]
        shapes=[[1,8192],[1,8192,4],[1,8192,4],[1,8192]];paths=[]
        for label,shape in zip(labels,shapes):

            assert item['dtype']=='bf16' and item['shape']==shape and p.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and sha(p)==item['sha256']

        assert len(selections)==1
        prefix=D/f'position{position}.layer{layer:02d}'

                if layout[key]==0:assert sha(p)==files[label]['sha256']
                actual.append(file_id(p))
        results.append(dict(position=position,layer=layer,transaction=tx['ordinal'],input_token_id=row['input_token_id'],

    current=[x for r in results if r['position']==position for x in r['comparison']['layouts']]
    print(json.dumps(dict(position=position,layouts=len(current),output_mismatches=sum(x['output_bf16_mismatches'] for x in current),
        history_mismatches=sum(x['active_history_bf16_mismatches'] for x in current))),flush=True)
layouts=[x for r in results for x in r['comparison']['layouts']]
summary=dict(cases=len(results),layouts=len(layouts),compared_output_bf16=len(layouts)*8192,compared_active_history_bf16=len(layouts)*24576,
    output_bf16_mismatches=sum(x['output_bf16_mismatches'] for x in layouts),
    output_f32_carrier_bit_mismatches=sum(x['output_f32_carrier_bit_mismatches'] for x in layouts),
    active_history_bf16_mismatches=sum(x['active_history_bf16_mismatches'] for x in layouts))
proof=dict(kind='qualified_reference_operands_offline_convolution_kernel_replay',utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    host=socket.gethostname(),source_commit=commit,reference_model=authority['model'],

    source=file_id(source),executable=file_id(exe),observer=file_id(Path(__file__)),
    generated_kernel=file_id(generated),generated_kernel_exact_original_body=True,
    mocked_execution='Remove only __global__/__device__ execution qualifiers and supply sequential one-dimensional block/thread coordinates. Invoke the exact extracted convolution body for both ring storage types. No reference output enters arithmetic.',
    verified_current_header_inputs=list(inputs.values()),silu_table=file_id(silu),compile_command=args,
    compile_stdout=compiled.stdout,compile_stderr=compiled.stderr,selected=selected,summary=summary,results=results,
    arithmetic_replay_only=True,native_windows_operands_compared=False,native_inference_executed=False,
    inference_acceptance=False,performance_acceptance=False,release_qualified=False)
out=D/'comparison.json'
with out.open('x') as f:json.dump(proof,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(file=str(out.relative_to(B)),sha256=sha(out),summary=summary)),flush=True)

conclusion: The exact c268 convolution kernel body, replayed with original GB10 operands at three positions for all30 layers, matches every BF16 output, widened F32 carrier and active history entry in both ring storage formats. The model weights come from the completed861 native diagnostic with separately matched263168 convolution surfaces; its full suffix output failed and remains unqualified. This CPU execution-coordinate mock does not establish GPU behavior, actual later Windows operands or the cause of the token divergence.
